study.comparator: insulin lispro three times daily (both arms on titrated insulin glargine)
study.notes: STUDY: 4B trial (NCT00960661), Diamant 2014 (Diabetes Care 37:2763-2773), the full paper of the group's 2013 abstract, reached through the institutional route; Table 2 with its footnotes and abstract and Methods sentences copied into work/fulltext/companion/diamant2014_4b_table2.txt; 30 week open label multicentre randomised noninferiority trial after 12 weeks of basal insulin optimisation, exenatide 10 to 20 ug/day (twice daily, dose_mg 0.01 per injection) vs mealtime insulin lispro three times daily, both added to titrated insulin glargine and metformin, 627 randomised; n_tx and n_ctrl are the per protocol population of Table 2 (247 and 263), the ITT population (316 and 321 per the Results text, marked ** rows in Table 2) is used for the adiponectin and hsCRP rows; contrast column exenatide minus lispro, LS mean difference with 95% CI (MMRM for the dagger rows, ANCOVA at end point for the double dagger rows; route ci_95); baselines at randomisation mean (SD) per arm; pct_weight_change -5.10 computed by the session: LS mean difference in body weight -4.6 kg over the n weighted randomisation weight (91.1*247 + 89.4*263)/510 = 90.22 kg; cardiovascular parameters were secondary outcomes (prespecified TRUE); Eli Lilly and Company/Amylin Pharmaceuticals Alliance study (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall some_concerns as in the RoB-2 row already recorded

json.design: randomised open label active comparator noninferiority trial, 30 weeks after 12 weeks of basal insulin optimisation, 627 randomised, 108 centres
json.reason: full paper of the group's 2013 abstract reached through the institutional route; replaces the abstract read (1 row, SBP by arm means and p) with 11 Table 2 rows carrying LS mean differences with 95% CI and baselines

rob.justification: S: the RoB-2 row already recorded for this trial applies (randomised, open label insulin regimens, per protocol primary analysis with MMRM, laboratory outcomes, secondary outcomes prespecified)

doubts: the paper states 637 randomised and 627 continuing (the abstract gives ITT n 627) while the Results text gives 316 and 321 ITT (sum 637); the Results text figures are used for the ITT rows
TC and LDL differences are printed to one decimal (-0.1 with CI -0.2 to 0.0), so the point estimates carry rounding error
the abstract read's SBP p value 0.0004 is replaced by the Table 2 footnote bound P < 0.001
